verdict.rationale: telli clearly stores call recordings and transcripts, which are viewable side-by-side in the app and analyzable per call. It also offers a REST API (with an OpenAPI spec) and webhooks that push call events and outcomes. However, no evidence says that recordings or transcripts can be fetched through the API or are included in webhook payloads, so programmatic retrieval is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for downloading recordings, a documented transcript retrieval endpoint or webhook payload field, coverage for every call, and independent corroboration.
